task: I need to set up a project for our 'Acme Corp HQ Redesign' client. I'll add key deliverables like 'Initial Concept Presentation', 'Material Selection Approval', and 'Final Blueprint Sign-off', organise them into a clear workflow, assign them to team members and set due dates. I'll post a message to the client thread and upload or write a document for the brief. Finally I'll look for a way to reuse this setup as a template for future client projects and find what is still pending approval.

observations.what: Sign-up was name/email/org plus a password page with an invisible hCaptcha and no email verification, reaching the app in about 11 steps.
The free plan's single pre-made 'My Project' starts with no tools, so To-dos, Message Board and Docs each have to be added one by one from an 'Add a tool' menu before any work can start.

One inline form held name, assignee (type-ahead 'Sam' -> Sam Rivera on Enter), 'when done' notify, due date picker, notes and subtasks, and the deliverable showed its assignee and 'Fri, Oct 30' chips on the list right after saving.
After saving, the form reopened for the next item, so typing a name and pressing Enter added each further deliverable in a single step.
Setting a due date took two extra clicks (open field, pick day in calendar), and picking a date expanded the form with a Repeat row that pushed the 'Add this to-do' button down.

There is no approval status or approval field on to-dos; the only way I found to see 'pending approval' was the to-do Filter box, a plain keyword match that showed 'Material Selection Approval' but not 'Final Blueprint Sign-off'.
The Filter box filtered instantly, highlighted the matched word and put the filter in the URL (?filter=Approval) so the view can be shared.

The project '...' menu offers settings, customize tools, copy link, webhooks and delete but no 'save as template', and clicking 'New project' on Home sent me straight to the upgrade/plans page, so templates were unreachable on Free.
The Home page immediately listed the new assigned deliverable 'Initial Concept Presentation (Demo Alpha)' under recent activity next to the project card.

I clicked Message Board and Docs in what I thought was still-open tool menu after adding To-dos; the menu had closed and nothing was added, costing two steps, and I ran out of steps before posting the client message or writing the brief.
